summary: Iteration 2: tested qty per dish, typed notes, the bill per table and closing it, the daily report, and regression flows. Backend: 20/20 pytest pass (5 new + 15 regression). Frontend (375x667 web preview): everything requested works end to end. Merging repeated taps into one line with qty, the +/- buttons (min 1), total and footer count are correct. The note modal saves typed text, keeps it on reopen, and Abbrechen closes it. The kitchen ticket shows '2×' and the text note with no play button. The bill shows the warning and a disabled button before serving. After preparing->ready->served, closing shows the toast 'Tisch 4 abgeschlossen · 51,00 €', goes back to /waiter and the table shows Frei. The 'Rechnung offen' tile shows. Both report buttons open /report with total, paid, open, top dish and per-waiter list. Login and logout for both roles work. No deprecated Expo packages found. Only minor issues remain (see action_items).

minor.issue: Race condition: it checks that all orders are served with find(), then calls update_many() with the same filter {table, paid != true}. An order sent between the two calls is marked paid while still 'new'. Update by the checked ids ({'id': {'$in': ids}}) instead.
Table numbers outside 1-10 (e.g. 99) return 400 'Keine offene Rechnung' instead of 404. GET /bill returns 404 for these.

ui_bugs.issue: router.replace('/waiter') leaves /waiter/table/{n} in history. Browser back from the tables screen goes to /waiter/table/4, and on native the stack becomes [waiter, table, waiter]. Use router.dismissTo('/waiter') or router.dismissAll(). Reference: /app/frontend/app/waiter/bill/[id].tsx:37

issues: The toast sits over the screen header (back button and title) for a few seconds, e.g. 'Als serviert markiert' covers the bill header. Consider placing it below the header or at the bottom.

action_items: close_table: update by the ids that were checked, not the open filter, to avoid marking a new unserved order as paid
close_table: return 404 for table numbers outside 1-10, as /bill does
Bill screen: after closing, use router.dismissTo('/waiter') instead of router.replace so the table screen is not left in the stack
Optional: use username instead of waiter_name as the React key in the report per-waiter list (report.tsx:128)
critical_code_review_comments: The report filters on created_at. An order created before midnight but paid today counts on the previous day, and revenue_paid only covers orders created today. This is fine if intended.
The startup migration marks old served orders without a 'paid' field as paid. It is safe and runs every time.
VoiceRecorderModal: saving empty text with no audio gives no note (checked). Typed text is trimmed on the server (checked).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_pizzaiolo_api.py (added cleanup: close tables 7 and 9 after the regression orders)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (one minor navigation issue)

seed_data_creation: No seed data. TEST orders on tables 4, 5, 9, 10 and 7 were served and closed (paid), so they count in today's report revenue as paid. Table 3's pre-existing 'new' order was not touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Kitchen screen has tabs kitchen-tab-new/preparing/ready. A ticket moves tabs after ticket-advance-{id}, so switch tabs before advancing again. The tests close their own tables. The pytest run uses xdist (parallel), so report-delta assertions use >=. Recording is not testable headless.
